title: MYCOLOGY
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the commonest form of superficial candidiasis."
Mucosal infections are the commonest form of superficial candidiasis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of simple hyphae and the thallus is well developed."
The coenocytic thallus is made up of simple hyphae and the thallus is well developed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an asymptomatic or relatively mild, self-limiting pulmonary infection, although chronic or acute disseminated disease may also occur."
Histoplasmosis is an asymptomatic or relatively mild, self-limiting pulmonary infection, although chronic or acute disseminated disease may also occur.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the presence of white candidal lesions within the eye (Candida endophythalmitis)."
The symptom is the presence of white candidal lesions within the eye (Candida endophythalmitis).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for spore production and usually extend from the medium into the air."
Reproductive mycelia are responsible for spore production and usually extend from the medium into the air.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are regarded as higher fungi. 5."
The two divisions Ascomycotina and Basidiomycotina are regarded as higher fungi. 5.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an intracellular parasite found in soil enriched with the droppings of birds and bats, and infection results from the inhalation of the spores."
The fungus is an intracellular parasite found in soil enriched with the droppings of birds and bats, and infection results from the inhalation of the spores.
fib: ______ is the drug of choice in the treatment of all forms of serious blastomycosis.
Intravenous amphotericin B is the drug of choice in the treatment of all forms of serious blastomycosis.
______ are known and recognized in the higher fungi. 1.
Two major groups are known and recognized in the higher fungi. 1.
______ is the sole site of infection from which it spreads into tissues as blood vessels causing thrombosis.
The lung is the sole site of infection from which it spreads into tissues as blood vessels causing thrombosis.
______ are used in the classification of fungi.
Several criteria are used in the classification of fungi.
______ are known to be cause of diseases of fishes and its egg thereby capable of affecting adult fish and fingerlings, egg hatcheries, lobsters, crabs and a number of aquatic animals.

Saprolegnial parasites are known to be cause of diseases of fishes and its egg thereby capable of affecting adult fish and fingerlings, egg hatcheries, lobsters, crabs and a number of aquatic animals.
______ are the principal organisms that have been used and the generic name for the microbial product is single cell protein.
Yeasts are the principal organisms that have been used and the generic name for the microbial product is single cell protein.
